prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a quiet library reading room filled with distinct characters and objects. On the far left, a tall bookshelf stands firmly against the wall, its shelves packed with colorful spines. Next to this bookshelf sits a woman in a blue dress, her posture upright as she reads a thick hardcover book. A small green plant rests on the floor beside her, adding a touch of nature to the scene. In the center of the room, a large wooden table dominates the space. A man in a red scarf sits at the head of this table, leaning forward slightly while pointing at an open map spread before him. Opposite him, a child in a yellow shirt looks intently at the same map, their eyes wide with curiosity. A brown dog lies calmly under the table, resting its head on its paws near the man's feet. To the right, a librarian in a gray vest stands behind a counter, handing a stamped card to a student in a green hoodie. The student reaches out eagerly to receive the card. Above them, a round clock hangs on the wall, showing the time as three o'clock. A stack of returned books sits neatly on the counter next to the librarian. There is no digital screen visible anywhere in the room, preserving the analog atmosphere. There is no coffee cup on any surface, keeping the focus strictly on the literature and interaction. The composition remains clean and uncluttered, emphasizing the simple shapes and bold colors typical of the style. Each element is clearly defined with sharp edges and solid fills, ensuring that every figure and object is easily distinguishable from the background. The spatial arrangement guides the viewer's eye from the solitary reader on the left to the engaged group in the center, and finally to the transaction on the right, creating a balanced narrative flow within the static image.
